title: Yellow Garlicky Peruvian Fish Picarones
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring crispy picarones filled with a garlicky fish seasoning, perfect for a snack or dessert. This egg-free friendly recipe is a show-off dish that is sure to impress.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potato, anise seeds, garlic, and fish seasoning, mixing well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar, yeast, and warm water, letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the yeast mixture to the sweet potato mixture, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees.
Once the oil is hot, use a spoon to drop small balls of the dough into the oil, frying until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the picarones from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Drizzle the melted score-fat over the picarones and serve immediately.
